core_info.summary: This health policy from HEALTH INSURANCE establishes a sum insured of ₹25,00,000 for primary medical coverage. However, it imposes critical financial room rent sub-limits, high specialist co-payment rates, and long waiting periods for chronic illnesses.

hidden_traps.title: 20% Mandatory Co-Payment
hidden_traps.original_text: The insured agrees to a mandatory co-payment ratio of 20% on all specialized surgery treatments and hospitalizations.
hidden_traps.plain_explanation: For every medical bill, you are forced to pay 20% of the total cost out of your own savings.
hidden_traps.impact: On a ₹5,00,000 major surgery claim, you must pay ₹1,00,000 cash yourself.
hidden_traps.advice: Request an insurance upgrade to a '0% Co-Pay' plan by paying a minor premium addition.

hidden_traps.title: 1% Room Rent Sub-Limit
hidden_traps.original_text: Hospital room rent charges are capped at a strict sub-limit of 1% of the overall Sum Insured per day.
hidden_traps.plain_explanation: The maximum the insurer pays for your hospital room per day is capped. Nicer rooms incur huge personal costs.
hidden_traps.impact: If room costs ₹10,000/day but limit is ₹5,000, you pay ₹5,000/day plus a proportional reduction on all doctor fees.
hidden_traps.advice: Insist on an insurance plan with 'No Room Rent Caps' to avoid treatment deductions.

hidden_traps.title: 36-Month Waiting Period
hidden_traps.original_text: A mandatory waiting period of 36 months applies to all claims related to diabetes, hypertension, and joint treatments.
hidden_traps.plain_explanation: You are barred from claiming any insurance benefits for chronic ailments during the first 3 years.
hidden_traps.impact: You must fund all treatments for diabetes, high blood pressure, or joint issues for 36 months.
hidden_traps.advice: Ask if you can pay an extra fee to reduce waiting periods to 12 months.

friendly_explanations.friendly_text: Insurer won't pay for premium luxury rooms during hospitalizations.

risk_score.verdict: This health policy covers massive sum insured limits but has severe room rent caps and co-pays. Perfect for basic hospitalization but expensive for premium ward rooms.
risk_score.top_risk_factor: Mandatory 20% co-payment rule on specialized surgeries.

suspicious_items.reason: Tying all medical expenses to the room rent sub-limit allows the insurer to trim your claims.
suspicious_items.original_text: Hospital room rent charges are capped at a strict sub-limit of 1% of the overall Sum Insured per day.
suspicious_items.industry_standard: All key rates, fees and penalties must be flat, transparent and capped.

reality_cost.shock_statement: You will pay ₹22,200 in premiums over 12 months, with an estimated ₹500,000 out-of-pocket co-pay exposure.

trust_score.transparency_note: Core cost items are stated but dynamic penalty margins are vague.
trust_score.fairness_note: Unilateral adjustment privileges heavily favor the lender's interest margins.
trust_score.complexity_note: Standard legal phrasing requires active review.
trust_score.trust_summary: The document utilizes industry standard boilerplate language but includes multiple unfavorable clauses.
